# Nik Dumroese — Marketing AI Engineer

> Nik (Niklaas) Dumroese is a marketing AI engineer. He builds measurement models, data pipelines and agents for marketing and GTM teams. Based in Germany, from Idaho. Available immediately. Contact: hello@nikdumroese.com

I build the measurement models, data pipelines and agents that marketing teams run on. Across my work, I build the system that produces a number I can check instead of trusting a reported one.

## Selected work

- A proactive GTM engine, built end-to-end: signal pipeline → enrichment → ICP + signal scoring → branched outreach → self-improving eval loop. Stack: Python, dbt, Clay, LLM copy layer, CRM automation, GitHub/PyPI/Docker APIs. Shipped as a live app + runnable scoring model; ~14× directional year-one ROI.
- Production multi-agent marketing system: 24/7 agentic infrastructure for a 30+ person team — orchestrator agents coordinating subagents, self-improving loops, RAG memory over a ~1,000-doc vector-indexed wiki, and eval frameworks with regression tracking.
- Decentralized multi-agent swarm, no orchestrator: Holacracy-inspired framework — independent roles coordinate via file-based mailboxes and mechanical governance (proposals integrate only once every other role has had a turn to object, computed from an append-only audit log, never decided by an LLM or human). Built on LangGraph for state/routing/parallel fan-out only; all judgment happens in a headless Claude Code subprocess. Reusable across use cases via swappable per-pack role configs; applied to a real live job search, with a dedicated fact-checking role enforcing a hard no-fabrication rule.
- Incrementality testing framework: from-scratch causal measurement in Python on ads-platform APIs; ~15% CAC improvement.
- GTM data infrastructure & conversion tracking: Segment CDP, server-side CAPI events, lifecycle-stage conversion tracking; ~7% CVR improvement and 2M€+ ARR uplift contribution.

## Lab (live, in-browser projects)

Working tools that run client-side on synthetic sample data or an uploaded CSV. Index: https://nikdumroese.com/lab/

- [Brand & claims gate for AI-written copy](https://nikdumroese.com/lab/claims-check/): Checks AI-written ad copy against brand voice, approved claims, competitor mentions and regulated wording, then passes, holds or blocks each draft.
- [CRM dedupe & standardiser](https://nikdumroese.com/lab/crm-dedupe/): Turns a messy contact export into one clean record per person and explains every merge. Your file stays in your browser.
- [Multi-agent swarm with no one in charge](https://nikdumroese.com/lab/agent-swarm/): Replays a real run in which agents agree on work without a coordinator. See why each proposal passed, then add an objection and watch the outcome change.
- [Governance layer for marketing agents](https://nikdumroese.com/lab/agent-governance/): Logs and checks every action a marketing agent takes, then records whether it would auto-approve, need review or be blocked. Decide the held ones and the weekly report updates.

## Open source

- [plain-language-skill](https://github.com/nikdumroese/plain-language-skill): agent skill for ISO 24495 plain-language writing.
- [audit-swarm](https://github.com/nikdumroese/audit-swarm): multi-agent swarm to audit code, verify research, or stress-test a plan.
- [crm-refine](https://github.com/nikdumroese/crm-refine): streaming CRM dedupe and field standardisation, dependency-free.
- [knowledge-base-ops](https://github.com/nikdumroese/knowledge-base-ops): token-efficient persistent knowledge base for LLMs over large corpora.
- [context-engineering](https://github.com/nikdumroese/context-engineering): patterns for token-efficient CLAUDE.md files and layered agent context.
- [agent-skills](https://github.com/nikdumroese/agent-skills): harness-agnostic collection of skills, commands, and eval patterns.
- [minto-pyramid](https://github.com/nikdumroese/minto-pyramid): restructure and pressure-test writing with the Pyramid Principle.

## Skills

Agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, MCP, RAG, vector search, evals), growth engineering (Python, SQL, BigQuery, dbt, incrementality testing), and GTM data (Segment CDP, CAPI, HubSpot, attribution).
